_comment: The Prayer world. `levels` are its levels, in the order they are climbed. Grow's Prayer world (frontend lib/grow/prayerLesson.js) reads it from /api/grow/worlds/prayer and teaches the steps with words to say, one phrase per item; the postures are left to the Fiqh world and the surahs to the Quran world, which teach them. `paths` are its recitation paths, one file each in paths/, in the order the map offers them, and `units` its files of cards (models/grow.py Card), each sitting in one level. A path names its tier (the tiers Grow used to list) and cuts its steps into groups: a group is one node on the map, `icon` names its picture, and every step sits in exactly one group. A ruling names its `source` (../../sources.json); its `arabic` is that source's own sentence, never paraphrased, and tests/test_grow.py holds every one to its source. A step with no clear sentence in the book carries no ruling.
